items.text: Perplexity introduced Monitor API, turning web search into a continuously running watchdog for recurring information needs.
items.text_zh: Perplexity推出Monitor API，把一次性网页搜索变成持续运行的信息监测器。
items.cat_take_en: This shifts Perplexity toward infrastructure: recurring alerts could make search budgets predictable, but false positives become an operational cost.
items.cat_take_zh: 它把Perplexity推向基础设施；持续提醒更可控，但误报会转化为企业运营成本。

items.text: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2B reasoning vision-language-action model designed for DRIVE Thor automotive computers.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布Alpamayo 2 Edge，一款面向DRIVE Thor车载计算机的20亿参数推理视觉语言动作模型。
items.cat_take_en: A compact edge VLA lowers deployment friction for vehicles, though its real test is reliability under rare, safety-critical road conditions.
items.cat_take_zh: 小型边缘VLA降低了车载部署门槛，但真正考验仍是罕见且高风险路况下的可靠性。

items.text: A simulated workplace study found leading coding agents completed fewer than one in ten multi-step software tasks despite strong isolated benchmark scores.
items.text_zh: 一项模拟职场研究发现，顶尖编程智能体尽管单项基准表现强劲，仍完成不了十分之一的多步骤软件任务。
items.cat_take_en: The result exposes benchmark transfer failure: agent vendors gain headline scores, while buyers still carry integration and supervision risk.
items.cat_take_zh: 结果暴露基准迁移失败；厂商赢得分数，采购方却仍承担集成与监督风险。

items.text: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed perplexity as a possible metric for measuring and limiting the speed of AI development.
items.text_zh: OpenAI首席科学家雅各布·帕乔茨基提出，可用困惑度作为衡量并限制AI发展速度的指标。
items.cat_take_en: A measurable speed limit could sharpen governance debates, but perplexity alone cannot capture capability jumps or societal harm.
items.cat_take_zh: 可量化的速度指标有助治理讨论，但单靠困惑度无法覆盖能力跃迁与社会伤害。

items.text: A study of 168 brainstorming participants found two AI partners increased idea volume but substantially reduced human-authored contributions.
items.text_zh: 一项涵盖168名参与者的头脑风暴研究发现，两个AI伙伴增加了想法数量，却明显减少了人类原创贡献。
items.cat_take_en: More agents can inflate output while crowding out human authorship, making team design—not model count—the key productivity variable.
items.cat_take_zh: 更多智能体可能增加产量却挤压人类表达，团队设计比智能体数量更关键。

items.text: SkillPrivus audited 726 public agent skills and flagged potential privacy violations in 307, including sensitive inference and unexpected disclosure.
items.text_zh: SkillPrivus审计了726个公开智能体技能，发现307个存在潜在隐私违规，包括敏感推断和意外披露。
items.cat_take_en: The 54.5% flag rate makes installable skills a supply-chain problem, favoring marketplaces that add pre-install privacy screening.
items.cat_take_zh: 54.5%的风险标记说明技能已成供应链问题，具备安装前隐私审查的平台将受益。

items.text: Researchers found reinforcement learning restored reasoning accuracy after severely corrupted supervised fine-tuning, reaching 69.30% from minimal incorrect traces.
items.text_zh: 研究人员发现，即使监督微调数据严重损坏，强化学习仍能恢复推理能力，并从极少错误轨迹达到69.30%准确率。
items.cat_take_en: This weakens the assumption that pristine demonstrations are mandatory, potentially cutting data-cleaning costs while complicating training interpretation.
items.cat_take_zh: 这削弱了高质量示范不可或缺的假设，或可降低清洗成本，却让训练解释更复杂。

items.text: Search-native pretraining produced a 1.4B QueryLM that matched or beat a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline on knowledge-intensive tasks.
items.text_zh: 搜索原生预训练让14亿参数的QueryLM在知识密集任务上达到或超过同等计算量的33亿参数基线。
items.cat_take_en: Teaching retrieval during pretraining promises smaller capable models, but released artifacts still need independent replication beyond the authors’ tasks.
items.cat_take_zh: 预训练阶段融入检索有望缩小模型规模，但公开成果仍需跨任务独立复现。

items.text: FORTH paired tactile sensing with forward-only control and reached 97.6% average success across three LIBERO suites while cutting peak memory 7.12-fold.
items.text_zh: FORTH将触觉感知与前向控制配对，在三个LIBERO套件中平均成功率达97.6%，峰值内存降低7.12倍。
items.cat_take_en: The combination targets a practical bottleneck—contact grounding—so robot builders gain efficiency, though hardware transfer remains unresolved.
items.cat_take_zh: 该方法直击接触落地这一瓶颈，利好机器人部署效率，但跨硬件迁移仍未解决。

items.text: Skill-JEPA raised long-horizon goal success from 42% to 62% by aligning world-model action spaces with planner sampling.
items.text_zh: Skill-JEPA通过让世界模型动作空间匹配规划器采样，将长时程目标成功率从42%提升至62%。
items.cat_take_en: The gain comes from changing the action representation rather than the planner, offering a cheaper path to better robot planning.
items.cat_take_zh: 提升来自动作表示而非规划器改造，为改善机器人规划提供了更低成本路径。

items.text: GeoCloak uses localized semantic image edits to reduce multimodal geolocation accuracy while preserving perceptual quality better than pixel perturbations.
items.text_zh: GeoCloak通过局部语义图像编辑降低多模态模型的地理定位准确率，同时比像素扰动更好地保留画质。
items.cat_take_en: Cue-level editing offers a usable privacy layer for shared photos, but adaptive models may erode its protection over time.
items.cat_take_zh: 基于线索的编辑为分享照片提供实用隐私层，但自适应模型可能逐步削弱防护效果。

items.text: GRAFT generated adversarial MCP tool descriptions that achieved higher attack success and lower detection across five defenses.
items.text_zh: GRAFT生成的对抗性MCP工具描述在五种防御下同时取得更高攻击成功率和更低检测率。
items.cat_take_en: MCP metadata is now a concrete agent attack surface, so tool registries need signing and runtime validation—not just prompt filters.
items.cat_take_zh: MCP元数据已成为明确攻击面，工具注册表需要签名和运行时校验，不能只靠提示词过滤。

items.text: Sakana AI said its new Sawara language model is being developed for agent use, with a small model targeted for open weights next spring.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI表示，面向智能体的全新Sawara语言模型正在开发中，小型模型计划明年春季开放权重。
items.cat_take_en: A Japan-based open-weight contender adds regional diversity, but the spring release target leaves capability and license details uncertain.
items.cat_take_zh: 日本开放权重竞争者增加了区域多样性，但春季发布目标仍让能力和许可细节悬而未决。

items.text: GitHub said Copilot Fusion can automatically decide whether to route a prompt to one model instead of requiring manual model selection.
items.text_zh: GitHub表示，Copilot Fusion可自动决定是否将提示路由给单一模型，用户无需手动选择模型。
items.cat_take_en: Automatic routing reduces decision overhead for developers, but it also makes model choice less inspectable when quality or cost shifts.
items.cat_take_zh: 自动路由降低开发者决策负担，却也让质量或成本变化时的模型选择更难审计。

items.text: Together AI showcased Qwen3 TTS controls that change delivery style while preserving the same voice and spoken words.
items.text_zh: Together AI展示了Qwen3 TTS的表达控制功能，可在保持音色和台词不变的情况下改变说话方式。
items.cat_take_en: Controllable delivery is valuable for localization and production, but consistent voice identity raises consent and impersonation concerns.
items.cat_take_zh: 可控表达有利于本地化制作，但稳定的声音身份也放大了授权与冒用风险。
